WPSS No.489 of 2014
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. B.M. Pingal, Advocate present for
the petitioner.
Mr. Vikas Pandey, Brief Holder present
for the State.
Petitioner claims to be a Rajya
Andolankari i.e. person who participated in
the movement for the creation of new State
of Uttarakhand. On that basis he was given
appointment in Public Service vide order
dated 21.11.2013. He had put in 90 days
his service and his services were terminated
vide order dated 01.03.2014.
The issue regarding reservation or
quota in service of Rajya Andolankari is
under consideration in a Public Interest
Litigation before a Division Bench of this
Court.
Mr. Vikas Pandey, Brief Holder who
appears for the State of Uttarakhand is
directed to furnish before this Court, an
affidavit of the Chief Secretary, Government
of Uttarakhand. The affidavit shall contain
the entire details such as names and
particulars of such persons who have been
given appointment as Rajya Andolankari, in
Uttarakhand State, in each Departments or
Govt. Corporation. The aforesaid details
shall be given within four weeks from today.
List this petition on 29.04.2014 in
daily cause list. Meanwhile, State counsel
shall also file counter affidavit to the
averments of the writ petition by the next
date of listing.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
JKJ 31.03.2014

WPSS No.1226 of 2011
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. B.P. Nautiyal, Senior Advocate assisted
by Mr. Mohd. Matloob, Advocate present for the
petitioners.
Mr. B.S. Negi, Dy. Advocate General present
for the State.
Mr. Rakesh Thapliyal, Advocate present for
the respondent No.3.
After hearing the learned counsel for the
parties at some length, it transpires that Principal
Secretary/Secretary (Karmik), Government of
Uttarakhand must bring on record by filing an
affidavit, the latest Government orders of the State
by which State has identified such posts which are
liable to be filled from amongst Physically
Challenged candidates, particularly those who are
blind or partially blind.
In the affidavit the said Official shall also
elaborate, while identifying such posts [under
mandate of section 32 of Persons with Disabilities
(Equal Opportunities, Protection of Rights and Full
Participation) Act, 1995], what has been the
criteria or logic for identifying such posts in the
Education Department.
The anxiety of this Court is to know whether
this exercise has been undertaken by the State
with the degree of seriousness, the provision
requires.
Put up this matter on 23.04.4014 in daily
cause list.
It is made clear, in case such affidavit is not
filed by the next date of listing, the Principal
Secretary/Secretary (Karmik) shall appear in
person before this Court alongwith entire record of
the case on the date fix.

(Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
